Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Runs a property test inside PostgreSQL, the counterpart of pgrx's <code>PgTestRunner</code>: it checks a condition
against many generated inputs, reports a backend error as a failing input, and shrinks a failing input to a
small one.

```csharp
public sealed class PgPropertyRunner
```

Each case runs in its own internal subtransaction, so a PostgreSQL error rolls back that case's work and the run
continues; a passing case keeps its changes in the enclosing transaction. Any exception from the test, including
a [PgException](/api/ankus.pgexception/), fails the case. Query cancellation and other operator-intervention errors stop the
run instead. Call it from a [PgTestAttribute](/api/ankus.pgtestattribute/) method or another backend callback.

<pre><code class="lang-csharp">[PgTest]
public static void DatesRoundTrip()
    =&gt; new PgPropertyRunner().Run(
        PgGenerators.Number&lt;int&gt;().Select(PgDate.FromRawSaturating),
        date =&gt; Assert(Spi.ExecuteScalar&lt;PgDate&gt;("SELECT $1", SpiParameter.Create(date)) == date));</code></pre>

### Run&lt;T&gt;(PgGenerator&lt;T&gt;, Action&lt;T&gt;)

Checks a property against generated inputs.


Type parameters:

`T`

Parameters:

`generator` — <code>PgGenerator&lt;T&gt;</code>

Exceptions:

- [PgPropertyException](/api/ankus.pgpropertyexception/): An input failed, with the smallest failing input as [Input](/api/ankus.pgpropertyexception/#member-047a43d98f6b9c16) and its failure as the
inner exception, or the generator rejected too many cases.
- [ArgumentOutOfRangeException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentoutofrangeexception): An option is outside its range.
